verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published forms directory and a Form 401 for changing a registered agent, but nothing documents what a third party may or may not file on an entity's behalf. There is no published authorization form for delegated filers, no definition of delegate roles, and no statement of which signatures must stay personal. The registered-agent form is an adjacent feature, not a published delegated-access policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
